svg.text: Layout A (phone 412x915): bottom sheet over the PR sheet
Dispatch on a finding opens a sheet over the Thread tab. One sheet per job, drag handle on top, keyboard-safe.
Job 1: one linked session. Job 2: several sessions, pick one. Job 3: no session, new worktree on the PR head.
Keyboard open. Sheet shrinks, buttons stay visible.
